9568-the-frost-spirit-and-other-poems-pa.title: Religious Poems
9568-the-frost-spirit-and-other-poems-pa.creator: John Greenleaf Whittier
9568-the-frost-spirit-and-other-poems-pa.description: A book by John Greenleaf Whittier. He comes,--he comes,--the Frost Spirit comes  You may trace his footsteps now On the naked woods and the blasted fields and the  brown hill's withered brow. He has smitten the leaves of the gray old trees  where their pleasant green came forth, And the winds, which follow wherever he goes,  have shaken them down to earth.

arxiv-2211-06519.title: The Expertise Problem: Learning from Specialized Feedback
arxiv-2211-06519.creator: Oliver Daniels-Koch, Rachel Freedman
arxiv-2211-06519.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is a powerful technique for training agents to perform difficult-to-specify tasks. However, human feedback can be noisy, particularly when human teachers lack relevant knowledge or experience. Levels of expertise vary across teachers, and a given teacher may have differing levels of expertise for different components of a task.

arxiv-2306-15006.title: DNABERT-2: Efficient Foundation Model and Benchmark For Multi-Species Genomes
arxiv-2306-15006.creator: Zhihan Zhou Yanrong Ji Weijian Li Pratik Dutta Ramana V Davuluri Han Liu
arxiv-2306-15006.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhihan Zhou Yanrong Ji Weijian Li Pratik Dutta Ramana V Davuluri Han Liu. Decoding the linguistic intricacies of the genome is a crucial problem in biology, and pre-trained foundational models such as DNABERT and Nucleotide Transformer have made significant strides in this area. Existing works have largely hinged on k-mer , fixed-length permutations of A , T , C , and G , as the token of the genome language due to its simplicity.

arxiv-2404-00179.title: Multi-Region Transfer Learning for Segmentation of Crop Field Boundaries in Satellite Images with Limited Labels
arxiv-2404-00179.creator: Hannah Kerner, Saketh Sundar, Manthan Satish
arxiv-2404-00179.description: Abstract The goal of field boundary delineation is to predict the polygonal boundaries and interiors of individual crop fields in overhead remotely sensed images (e.g., from satellites or drones). Automatic delineation of field boundaries is a necessary task for many real-world use cases in agriculture, such as estimating cultivated area in a region or predicting end-of-season yield in a field.

arxiv-2501-09217.title: Adaptive Law-Based Transformation (ALT): A Lightweight Feature Representation for Time Series Classification
arxiv-2501-09217.creator: Marcell T. Kurbucz, Balázs Hajós, Balázs P. Halmos, Vince Á. Molnár, Antal Jakovác
arxiv-2501-09217.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marcell T. Kurbucz, Balázs Hajós, Balázs P. Halmos, Vince Á. Molnár, Antal Jakovác. Time series classification (TSC) is fundamental in numerous domains, including finance, healthcare, and environmental monitoring. However, traditional TSC methods often struggle with the inherent complexity and variability of time series data. Building on our previous work with the linear law-based transformation (LLT)—which improved classification accuracy by transforming the feature space based on key data patterns—we introduce adaptive law-based transformation (ALT).

arxiv-2502-00433.title: CAT Pruning: Cluster-Aware Token Pruning For Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
arxiv-2502-00433.creator: Xinle Cheng, Zhuoming Chen, Zhihao Jia ‡
arxiv-2502-00433.description: Abstract Diffusion models have revolutionized generative tasks, especially in the domain of text-to-image synthesis; however, their iterative denoising process demands substantial computational resources. In this paper, we present a novel acceleration strategy that integrates token-level pruning with caching techniques to tackle this computational challenge. By employing noise relative magnitude, we identify significant token changes across denoising iterations.

pmc-12466762.title: YOLOv8-DMC: Enabling Non-Contact 3D Cattle Body Measurement via Enhanced Keypoint Detection
pmc-12466762.creator: Zhi Weng, Wenwen Hao, Caili Gong, Zhiqiang Zheng, Andrea Pezzuolo
pmc-12466762.description: Simple SummaryAccurately measuring the body size of cattle is essential for health monitoring and effective farm management. Traditional manual methods are time-consuming, labor-intensive, and may cause stress to the animals. In this study, we developed an automated, non-contact system that combines image-based keypoint detection with 3D depth data to estimate key body measurements.

pmc-12689947.description: Osteosarcoma is a primary bone malignancy in which outcomes for patients with metastatic or relapsed disease remain unsatisfactory despite optimized surgery–chemotherapy backbones.
